title: Identical Bags
body:
You have n distinct objects and k identical bags. Count the ways to put every object into a bag so that no bag is empty. The bags cannot be told apart, so only which objects end up together matters.

Print the answer modulo 109 + 7.

Function to complete

Complete countWays(n, k). It returns the number of ways modulo 109 + 7.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.

samples.ex: 4 ways to split 1 + 3 and 3 ways to split 2 + 2.

py.pre:
from typing import *
import sys, math, collections, heapq, bisect, itertools, functools
from collections import *
py.post:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    _raw = sys.stdin.read(); _t = _raw.split(); _p = 0
    n = int(_t[_p]); _p += 1
    k = int(_t[_p]); _p += 1
    _r = Solution().countWays(n, k)
    print(_r)
